quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a crosswalk ahead. Watch for people walking across the road.

questions.question: An orange and red triangle on a vehicle always means:
questions.explanation: Farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back to show they move slowly.

questions.question: This sign shows a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At this crossing, you must look both ways, listen for trains, and be prepared to stop if a train is coming. Never try to drive faster than an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must go. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign say?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark areas where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of dangers ahead. This sign marks a crosswalk. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road splits; you must go right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits; you must go right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warnings. This sign warns you that the road splits into two paths. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warnings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The speed limit is 35 mph after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve.
Drive 35 mph or slower around the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive 35 mph or slower around the curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs warn you of dangers ahead. This sign shows a recommended speed for the curve. Slow down to 35 mph or less when you reach the curve.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only on a green arrow.
You can turn left on a green light when it is safe.
You must wait for a solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any cars, bicycles, or pedestrians pass first. Then you may follow the sign's directions and proceed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What type of road condition does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and get ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection so you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp left and right turns ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a winding road ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them extra space to merge safely.
Traffic is merging from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them extra space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors. If possible, move to another lane to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Turn on your signal and merge at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for traffic on the other road to pass. You do not need a complete stop if no cars are coming, but always slow down and enter with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Get ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height for vehicles in this state.
The maximum width for vehicles on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much space there is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. When a bicyclist extends their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn in this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully and slowly.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming up. Start slowing down when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, you must let other vehicles and pedestrians pass first. Slow down and stop if needed before you go ahead.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers. They show where to find rest areas, food, hospitals, and other helpful services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this intersection.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Look for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are near a school or school crossing. When you see this sign, stay alert and prepare to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are coming to a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are coming to a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go across the tracks.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic must move left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic must move left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions right ahead. This sign warns that the road has fewer lanes ahead and you need to move left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Parking space reserved for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking space reserved for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking permits.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A left turn is allowed only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must drive through the intersection at this speed.
The highest safe speed is 55 mph under good conditions.
You must not drive slower than this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed is 55 mph under good conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed limit for this road. You can drive slower if conditions require it, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mark work zones. If you see orange signs, stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign means a person with a flag is ahead directing traffic, and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Road work or maintenance is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, repair, and work areas. These signs help drivers and walkers stay safe in dangerous zones. Traffic fines may be double in work zones.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that road work is coming up. In a work zone, stay alert for temporary traffic control signs and devices.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Get ready. Traffic will merge into your lane from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get ready. Traffic will merge into your lane from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about situations ahead. This sign warns of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare to turn or watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves.

questions.question: A five-sided sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to school zones. These signs warn that children or pedestrians may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and move to the right lane.
If you are driving slowly, stay in the right lane.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are driving slowly, stay in the right lane.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs give important rules. This sign tells drivers to keep the left lane open for faster traffic and passing.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has curves and turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to possible hazards. This sign warns you to slow down and be careful when the road is wet.

questions.question: This sign is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangle-shaped sign means you must yield. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Stop at a marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What is this sign?
questions.explanation: A triangle-shaped sign is always a yield sign. You must slow down or stop when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way road and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may cross here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs show you are near a school or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. Orange-colored signs usually indicate construction areas.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows traffic laws you must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Do not travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs mean an action is not allowed. This sign means you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this intersection. It is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic will merge from the right. Be prepared to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are on a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you of two-way traffic.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop. Yield to others who have the right-of-way. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign directs traffic to pass on the right side of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs have a yellow or yellow-green background. They warn you about upcoming road conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to places where bicycles, animals, or people may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a curve to the right.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only" below it, what should you do?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you that you must move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: When approaching a railroad crossing, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic signals are at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. This sign posted at an intersection means you cannot turn right or left when the traffic light is red.

questions.question: This white sign means you cannot pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule. This sign means do not pass other vehicles at any time.

questions.question: This symbol is used for:
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle shows it moves slowly. You see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, and horse-drawn wagons. It looks solid orange during the day and hollow red at night.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign where traffic comes from the opposite direction.

questions.question: This sign indicates a:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black marks warn drivers about upcoming dangers. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is put on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A downgrade or steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downgrade or steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a downgrade or steep hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A side road meets this road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road meets this road ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to situations they might not see. This sign tells you that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: This sign means you:

options.text: Can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can turn left or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your lane will split into two directions. In a lane with this sign, you may turn left or continue straight.

questions.question: What should you do if you want to turn left at this traffic signal?

options.text: Turn if you yield to other drivers.
Stop and then proceed when safe.
Stop and stay stopped while the red arrow shows.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and stay stopped while the red arrow shows.
questions.explanation: When you see a red left arrow at a traffic signal, you must stop before the intersection. Stay stopped until the red arrow is gone.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: A railroad crossing is controlled ahead.
Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.

questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal picture warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Get ready to follow the signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided road and entering a road with traffic going both directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic rules that you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction areas. Drive carefully in these zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed where you are not allowed to enter. You may see it on one-way streets or expressway ramps where you are going the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roads. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until it is safe to cross the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean when shown on the back of a vehicle?

options.text: The vehicle is pulled by an animal.
The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, or farm equipment may show this sign. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will only go 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right has one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right because of construction.
The road ahead changes direction sharply.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a sharp change in road direction coming up. Slow down and be ready.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Check for vehicles in the direction you plan to go, then go.
Check for traffic in all directions before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before going.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and check all directions for traffic before going.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red light?

options.text: You are going the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Turning right at this intersection is unsafe and illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you to slow down because it takes longer to stop on wet pavement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is ahead.
Slow down and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign shows a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.
